name: Kinetik
description:
Kinetik is an AI agent for content creators and marketers — it researches your niche, analyzes what works, drafts copy in your voice, and runs recurring tasks on schedule. It lives in your messenger and learns your context.

This connector brings your Kinetik agents into Claude: the one you've trained on your own context, and the ones other people have shared with you. Ask Claude to list your agents, hand them work, and get their replies back without leaving the conversation.

What you can do:
- See the agents you can reach and what each one helps with
- Delegate real work: niche research, a weekly content plan, copy in your voice
- Ask an agent shared with you about the knowledge its owner gave it
- Refine in follow-ups — the conversation keeps its context

Every agent carries an access level set by its owner (read-only or full access); the connector enforces it and cannot change it.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Kinetik to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Kinetik to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://kineto.app/api/agents/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Kinetik MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kinetik provides these MCP tools: list_agents, send_message, and wait_for_reply.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Kinetik?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Kinetik in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Kinetik requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Kinetik is developed by Kineto. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
